title: Directory-level PIA custody needs later exact-byte freeze
description: PIA item source families are present with manifests/checksums, but CGP-003 did not rerun every nested package parity check for exact guide source freeze.
required_action: Complete item-level exact-byte freeze before guide adoption.
disposition_authority: Founder or later authorized Code Guide prompt

title: Current code/test behavior is unmapped to authority
description: Current backend, frontend, test, and CI files are evidence only and remain unmapped to source authority or future controls.
required_action: Execute CGP-004 current-state repository and architecture assessment.
disposition_authority: Founder or later authorized Code Guide prompt

title: External standard/provider references require later authority decisions
description: Referenced standards and providers such as WCAG, JWT, GitHub Actions, RFC 5545, Stripe, DocuSign, MongoDB, and Capacitor are inventoried but not newly adopted.
required_action: Raise guide-specific open decisions only where drafting needs binding standard choices.
disposition_authority: Founder or later authorized Code Guide prompt

title: Candidate/history/adopted/locked families coexist
description: Multiple lifecycle stages intentionally remain in repository custody. Downstream guide work must cite controlling source IDs and avoid treating candidates as adopted.
required_action: Use source supersession register during source freeze.
disposition_authority: Founder or later authorized Code Guide prompt

title: Historical manifests are point-in-time evidence
description: Historical checksum/manifests may not match current mutable targets. They remain evidence, while current aggregate manifests govern current-state claims.
required_action: Preserve historical manifests and use current manifests for current-state claims.
disposition_authority: Founder or later authorized Code Guide prompt
